doubts: One way only: the page describes the single Mount Bealey Track, which ends at the bushline. The shape is out_and_back from DOC's distance 'return via same track' and time '2-4 hours return to the bushline'; no page sentence says the return in words. The time and distance are DOC's own summary for the way. The end is the bushline, which has no feature or name in the packet, so its ref is null. The Mount Bealey summit is above the bushline with no track or marked route, so it is not part of the way. The 'Arthur's Pass' view is ambiguous between the place and the pass, so no ref.
